extDescription.message: Reads the cert number from a PSA or CGC slab photo you choose and opens the official verification page. Images stay on your device.

stateIdle.message: Right-click a slab photo on a web page and choose “Scan slab cert number”, or add an image below.

stateBarcode.message: Looking for barcodes and QR codes…

stateAutoOpen.message: Opened $GRADER$ cert $NUMBER$ in a new tab.

stateConfirm.message: Check the number and grader, then open the cert page.

stateConfirmGrader.message: Number found. Choose the grader, then open the cert page.

stateNone.message: No certification number found. Try a sharper image, or type the number below.

stateNotAuthenticity.message: The grader’s page shows the record for this number. A matching record does not prove that the slab itself is genuine.

errorRestricted.message: Chrome doesn’t allow extensions to read this page. Save the image and upload it, or copy and paste it here.

errorNotFound.message: The image is no longer on the page. Try again, or upload the image.

errorTooLarge.message: This image is too large to scan. Use a smaller copy.

errorFetchFailed.message: The site didn’t let CertScanner read this image. Upload or paste the image instead.

errorCaptureFailed.message: The image couldn’t be captured from the screen. Upload or paste the image instead.

errorTabChanged.message: The tab changed before the image could be read. Go back to the page and try again.

errorInvalidImage.message: This isn’t an image CertScanner can read.

errorEngineFailed.message: Text recognition couldn’t start. Close and reopen the side panel, then try again.

errorTimeout.message: The scan took too long. Try again, or use a smaller image.

errorManualEmpty.message: Type a cert number, for example PSA 12345678.

errorManualNoNumber.message: No cert number found in what you typed.

errorManualBadLength.message: That number has the wrong number of digits for this grader.

errorManualInvalid.message: Use digits, optionally with the grader name (PSA, CGC comics, CGC cards).

errorManualUntrustedUrl.message: Only cert links from psacard.com, cgccomics.com or cgccards.com can be used.

errorManualTooLong.message: That’s too long to be a cert number.

errorBadNumber.message: Enter a cert number with the right number of digits for this grader.

errorSettingsSave.message: Couldn’t save the setting. Try again.

errorPermissionDenied.message: Access not granted. You can still upload or paste the image.

warningQrUntrusted.message: This image has a QR code that points to $HOST$, which is not an official grader site. It was not opened.

warningLowResolution.message: Low-resolution image: check the number carefully.

warningOcrUnavailable.message: Text recognition is unavailable; showing barcode results only.

labelDropHint.message: Drop a slab photo here, paste it (Ctrl+V), or

labelManualInput.message: Cert number or official cert link

settingsAutoOpen.message: Open the cert page automatically when the result is clear (off = always ask)

settingsOpenInBackground.message: Open cert pages in a background tab

settingsSaveHistory.message: Keep a list of recent scans on this device

settingsHistoryOffConfirm.message: Turning this off deletes your recent scans.

settingsSitesEmpty.message: None. CertScanner only asks for a site when you choose “Sharper scans”.

footerDisclaimer.message: Not affiliated with PSA or CGC.

footerPrivacy.message: Images are processed on this device and never uploaded.
